raw_segments.text: In vain, cried Ahab, but maybe tease well, for did ye three but once take the full forced
shock than mine own electric thing that had perhaps expired from out me? Perchance, too,
it would have dropped ye dead. Perchance ye need it not. Down lances. And now ye mates
I do appoint ye three cup-bearers to my three pagan kinsmen there, yon three most honourable
gentlemen and noblemen my valiant harpooniers. Disdain the task.
What, when the great pope washes the feet of beggars, using his tiara for ewer? O my sweet
cardinals, your own condescension that shall bend ye to it. I do not order ye, ye will it.
Cut your ceasings and draw the poles ye harpooniers.
